messages:
deploy-bot: starting CONFIG-ONLY deploy to CANARY (thin-split). change-window=2026-05-10T03:00Z..2026-05-10T04:30Z. high level: tighten limits + lower batch window. relnotes: https://go/relnotes/slimline-safety 

tara: config blob: 
```
routing: split
weights: { canary: 0.08, stable: 0.92 }
batching:
  max_requests: 5
  window_ms: 30
  concurrency_limit: 12
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 1800
limits:
  tenant_floor_qps: 0.02
  per_tenant_burst: 40
```

evan: tagging oncall. I'll monitor p99, errors, and tenant burst counters.

miles: can we add autofallback to `v2-lite-quant` if p99>850ms for 90s? safer to have it armed but not enabled without ACK.

ops-bot: recommended runbook: https://go/runbooks/config-canary. will post incident if autofallback triggers.

deploy-bot: applied to pool: canary-thin (id: p-thin-11). initial split 8%. health checks started.

tara: smoke check: `curl -s -H "X-Tenant: demo" https://api.redwood.internal/gen` -> 200 OK, latency median ~65ms.

evan: small alert created: canary.p95 > 350ms -> notify #eng-oncall.

miles: request tweak: reduce per_tenant_burst to 30 for canary only to limit noisy spikes.

tara: ok to apply for canary. will not change cluster-wide.

deploy-bot: updated canary diff: `limits.per_tenant_burst=30` applied.

evan: 12m in: p50=58ms p95=140ms p99=320ms. cache hit-rate steady.

miles: try a 20% increase? prefer step: 8% -> 20% -> 40% if stable.

deploy-bot: attempt to increase to 20% blocked by quota guard (quota_limit). reverting to 8%.

evan: who's owner of the quota guard? @julia do you have a minute?

julia: I'll raise guard for 30m then revert. doing it now.

julia: guard bumped. attempting 20% now.

deploy-bot: split updated to { canary: 0.20, stable: 0.80 }. performing 10m validation.

evan: 6m into 20%: p99=360ms errors normal. no regressions.

miles: ran targeted multi-tenant regen: tail improved vs previous baseline. thumbs up.

tara: plan to hold 20% for 15m then move to 40% if stable. leaving note in relnotes: "batching max_requests reduced to 5, window to 30ms; per-tenant burst limited in canary."

ops-bot: scheduled revert of quota guard at 04:00Z. reminder set.

deploy-bot: at 04:10Z canary promoted; split removed; cluster config updated. config-diff: https://go/config/diff/1799998888 metrics: https://go/metrics/snap/1799998888

evan: final smoke OK. no rollback. closing thread.
